governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust.

candidates.intent: Search Wikipedia and return article summaries/content for a query term.

candidates.intent: Synthesize speech audio from text via ElevenLabs.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model cannot produce audio output.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Delegates speech synthesis to a TTS backend to fulfill audio outputs.
candidates.verify_note: Requires ElevenLabs key; generative audio. LlamaIndex tool package.

candidates.intent: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech via Azure Cognitive Speech.
candidates.input_contract: audio bytes or text plus locale/voice parameters
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model cannot transcribe audio or synthesize speech.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic-ish ASR/TTS via a hosted speech service.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Azure Speech key. LlamaIndex tool package.

candidates.intent: Translate text between languages via Azure Translator.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: For low-resource languages a bare model's translation quality is poor and unverifiable.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Hosted translation backend improves coverage with a dedicated MT system.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Azure Translator key. LlamaIndex tool package.

candidates.intent: Run image analysis/OCR via Azure Computer Vision.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text-only model cannot read text from images or detect objects.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Hosted vision/OCR extracts structured data from images.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Azure Vision key. LlamaIndex tool package.

candidates.intent: Convert natural language to SQL and query a database via Waii.
candidates.output_contract: generated SQL plus query result rows
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot reliably generate correct SQL against a real schema or read live rows.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Schema-aware NL-to-SQL plus execution returns grounded query results.
candidates.verify_note: NL-to-SQL non-deterministic; execution deterministic. Requires Waii key. LlamaIndex tool package.

candidates.intent: Query a Vectara managed RAG index for grounded answers with citations.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot search a private indexed corpus or cite its passages.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Managed RAG returns grounded answers with source citations from a tenant corpus.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Vectara account; present in LlamaIndex and LangChain.

candidates.intent: Create and manage payments, customers, and invoices via Stripe.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot move money or read live billing state.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Live Stripe API enables governed payment/billing actions and reads.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Stripe key; irreversible money movement MUST be approval-gated.

candidates.intent: Invoke an AWS Lambda function as an agent tool.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot run server-side compute or trigger cloud functions.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Delegates arbitrary server-side logic to deterministic serverless functions.
candidates.verify_note: Requires AWS credentials; egress/exec gating advised.

candidates.intent: Query Tableau dashboards/data sources for business-intelligence answers.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot read a tenant's live BI data or current dashboards.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Live Tableau access returns real current BI data for grounded answers.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Tableau auth; listed in LangChain integrations.

candidates.intent: Run Robocorp Action Server automations as agent tools.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot execute deterministic RPA automations against real systems.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Bridges to RPA actions for governed real-world task execution.
candidates.verify_note: Robocorp/Sema4 Action Server; listed in LangChain integrations.

candidates.intent: Get current date/time information (now, today, day of week, offsets).
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A frozen model does not know the current date/time and fabricates 'now'.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns the real current time deterministically from the host clock.
candidates.verify_note: Microsoft Semantic Kernel is MIT-licensed; core built-in plugin.

candidates.intent: Perform exact arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide).
candidates.gap_hypothesis: LLMs make arithmetic errors on large or chained calculations.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Delegates arithmetic to deterministic numeric operations.
candidates.verify_note: Semantic Kernel core built-in plugin (MIT).

candidates.intent: Deterministic text manipulation (trim, uppercase, lowercase, concat).
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Using an LLM for trivial string ops is wasteful and occasionally inconsistent.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Provides deterministic, free string transforms to the agent.
candidates.verify_note: Semantic Kernel core built-in plugin (MIT).

candidates.intent: Read from and write to the local filesystem.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot read or persist real files.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Deterministic file I/O grounds answers in actual file contents.
candidates.verify_note: Semantic Kernel core built-in plugin (MIT); filesystem access should be sandboxed.

candidates.intent: Summarize a running conversation transcript.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Long transcripts overflow context; raw model recall degrades over length.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Structured summarization plugin compresses transcripts to fit context windows.
candidates.verify_note: Semantic Kernel core plugin (MIT); itself LLM-backed so low determinism.

candidates.intent: Fetch X/Twitter posts and user timelines.
candidates.output_contract: list of posts/timeline entries with metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot read live social posts or post-cutoff timelines.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns real current X/Twitter content for grounding.
candidates.verify_note: Haystack tool integration; requires Xquik access. Verify ToS for social data use.

candidates.intent: Scrape and structure website data using LLM-guided extraction.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot fetch live pages or reliably structure their content.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Combines fetch + guided extraction to return structured current page data.
candidates.verify_note: Requires ScrapeGraph key; LLM-guided extraction lowers determinism.

candidates.intent: Scrape web/SERP content via the Oxylabs Web Scraper API.
candidates.input_contract: target URL or SERP query plus options
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot reach anti-bot-protected live web content.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Provides unlocked live web/SERP data across sites for grounding.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Oxylabs account; listed in LangChain integrations.

candidates.intent: Get a synthesized web answer with sources via the Perplexity API.
candidates.output_contract: answer text plus cited source URLs and dates
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot retrieve current web answers with live citations.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Returns sourced, dated answers for grounding without managing search infra.
candidates.verify_note: Requires Perplexity API key (paid w/ free tier per LangChain docs).

candidates.intent: Discover and execute actions across 500+ SaaS toolkits via a single governed router.
candidates.input_contract: action name (e.g. GITHUB_CREATE_ISSUE) plus parameters, or a discovery query
candidates.output_contract: action execution result or list of matching tools
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot perform real authenticated actions across hundreds of SaaS apps.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: A single OAuth-managed router executes governed real actions across 500+ apps.
candidates.verify_note: Composio catalog claims 500+ apps; individual outward actions must be approval-gated. Treat as a meta-toolkit candidate.

candidates.intent: Equip an LLM with hosted tools (code interpreter, web search, webpage reader, memory, send-email) via one API.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot run code, search the web, read pages, persist memory, or send email.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Hosted bundle adds 40+ governed real-world tools behind one integration.
candidates.verify_note: Toolhouse states 40+ tools incl. code interpreter, web search (Google/Tavily/Exa), memory, SendGrid email; license not stated on tools page — confirm before relying. Meta-bundle candidate.

candidates.intent: Fetch the raw content of one or more URLs for downstream processing.
candidates.output_contract: list of fetched content byte streams
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot fetch the live content behind a URL.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Deterministically retrieves current page bytes for grounding pipelines.
candidates.verify_note: Haystack is Apache-2.0; core component used in web-RAG pipelines.
